answer: Each identity grows a trellis of completed verifiable tasks, and every new task must attach to the existing lattice, so a fresh alias starts bare while an established agent carries a tall structure. Identities that vouch for one another form a reef: if any member is caught running Sybil aliases, the whole reef forfeits its staked bond. Each epoch the garden demands fresh tended work, and any plot left untended withers, forcing attackers to pay continuous upkeep for every alias instead of creating them once for free.
